title: Prescriptions Terms for Patients: Collecting a Filled Prescription
content:
A filled prescription under Kestrel Prescriptions is released once, to the patient or, where the class allows caregiver pickup, to a caregiver the patient names.

## Conditions of release

1. **Once only.** A fill is released once. A fill already named by a pickup entry, or already returned to stock, is not released again; a fill that has been returned to stock cannot be released and must be filled again.
2. **Age.** The person collecting must be at least the class's minimum pickup age.
3. **Photo ID.** Photo ID is checked and recorded as verified when the patient collects and the class requires ID at pickup, or when a caregiver collects and the class requires caregiver ID.
4. **Pickup locker.** The pickup locker channel is used only where the class allows locker pickup and the store has a pickup locker.
5. **Drive-thru.** The drive-thru channel is used only where the class allows drive-thru pickup and the store has a drive-thru.
6. **Home delivery.** The home delivery channel is used only where the class is delivery eligible and the patient holds a delivery plan in enrolled, active or past due status; a delivered fill of a class that requires a delivery signature is handed over only against an adult signature under the delivery charter. The delivery plan's status is read from the system record for the patient.

## Photo ID check (from the class settings)

| Who collects | Class requires patient ID | Class requires caregiver ID | ID checked and recorded as verified |
|---|---|---|---|
| patient | yes | any | yes |
| caregiver | any | yes | yes |

## Home delivery (hypothetical patients, class delivery eligible)

| Delivery plan status | Home delivery |
|---|---|
| enrolled | may be used |
| active | may be used |
| past due | may be used |
| no delivery plan held | may not be used |

**A fill of a delivery-eligible class that requires a signature goes by home delivery.** It is handed over only against an adult signature.

**The store has no pickup locker although the class allows one.** The locker channel is not used; both conditions must hold.
